notes: V35 (CR 704.5d, 111.7, 111.8): a 1/1 Soldier token dies and ceases to exist, so Rise Again ('Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield') has no legal target and cannot be cast: the token is not a card and is not in the graveyard. Before V35 the dead token stayed in the graveyard and was Rise Again's only target.
